notes.title: May 2020 Bug Fixing - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]The Blackout Club has been updated with several bug fixes and improvements.[/b]

We have been testing this build in several public tests with the community and are pleased with the stability improvements added. At long last, they are live on the main branch for everyone. :)

If you're looking for the latest updates on what has been happening with Enhanced Horror and the game community, we recommend visiting our official Discord server (discord.gg/theblackoutclub) or our official wiki on Gamepedia. You can also check out the hashtag #redacrespeaks on Twitter.

[h2]List of bugfixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The highest quality lighting build we've made yet, with fixes for a few problem areas as well.
[*] Added a Photo Sensitive Mode for players who experience issues with "The Call" curse. You can set this in the Options menu under the "Video" tab.
[*] Fix for ciphers occasionally not granting a curse
[*] Tweaks to balance of "The Hunger" curse
[*] Numerous fixes for AI pathfinding in problem areas (thanks to users who reported these using F8 or via our official Discord)
[*] Fix for a softlock that occurs with gamepad when attempting to remember a dream while it is downloading
[*] Fix for "Follow the trail" mission which in rare cases could not have a trail for clients
[*] Fix for the journal menu UI when viewing empty ritual response list
[*] Fix for rare load screen hang
[*] Fix for possible "stuck on black screen" bugs
[*] Fix for FX from speaker barrier being stuck on if you are suppressed near one
[*] Fix for bugs in exorcism HUD if you collect masks before the mission starts
[*] Fix for some hunger curse screen fx persisting when they shouldn't
[*] Fix to prevent losing quest items in the place between
[*] Fix to prevent "Gorgon" curse fx being applied to host when viewed by a suppressed player with curse
[*] Fix to prevent falling in "The Place Between" on machines under our recommended minimum spec
[*] Fixed Hunt-The-Strong sacrifice numbers showing on the sacrifice table
[*] Fixes to some skin tone bugs with certain clothing items
[*] Stability fixes
[*] Misc. UI fixes
[/list]

We also fixed some bugs on our online backend server code which had been causing some "Error Connecting to PlayFab" error messages as well as not always showing things like correct XP totals at the mission conclusion screen. This server fix was already live, but had not been called out in prior patch notes.

Thank you as always for playing and your support of The Blackout Club! 

See you around the neighborhood! 
>Question


[i]UPDATE MAY 19: We were getting reports of a crash for some users with this build. We tested and uploaded a new build this morning with a hotfix for that issue. Thanks to all who reported it![/i]

notes.title: The Blackout Club Update: A Curse on Redacre
notes.content:
The Blackout Club Cursed Update is live! The town of Redacre is isolated in the Radio Quiet Zone — but the shadow of a new threat has fallen across it. The locals dare not even speak its name...You’ll have to be extra careful and quick when running around the neighborhood, because not only did we add two new missions, but also the ability to pick up Cursed Ciphers (making your mission harder and more rewarding), the mysterious Place Between and more.

[h1]NEW MISSIONS [/h1]

[h3]Trace Race[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/0c00419cacf5f47129681d3c33c44a68b78844a7.png[/img]

– Traverse down into the maze, find the data tap with the Chorus spyware and discover who they are watching. Once you’ve successfully done that, you’ll have to get to the surface to record the information they are tracking. You can grab the data from more than one computer, too. But you’ll have to be swift; once Chorus closes the connection between the machine and all of the computers, you’ll have to start all over again. The Trace Race mission unlocks at Level 3.

[h3]Shadow People[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/a5bfe2f9aa4f4dc4cf0db2a45a45d08bee8b14b8.png[/img]

– In the mission “Shadow People”, the club is trying to collect information about a forbidden language spoken by the mysterious Voices, in the hopes of eventually being able to understand and synthesize it. This ancient code lies in the subconscious and has been hidden inside electronic Sleep Masks found around Redacre. You must collect these masks imprinted with fragments of the so-called “Old Tongue” and return them to the portable exorcism kit. But be careful. This mission and all who participate are marked... This mission unlocks at Level 10. 

[h1] CURSED CIPHERS[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/ea9a80a1147bdb3d29ba7fd398572c4403bc0dc0.png[/img]

– Now in The Blackout Club, you can collect Cursed Ciphers. Cursed Ciphers act very similar to regular evidence, but are very often in hard-to-reach, exposed, or dangerous places. Players that get close enough to see Cursed Ciphers will notice a tablet with a glitchy screen, emanating a strange and unexplainable sound. 

– When you pick up a Cursed Cipher, the collecting player is [u][b]CURSED[/b][/u]. 

[h1]CURSES[/h1]

– You don’t only have to worry about one curse. You can pick up multiple curses, leading you to try and escape while under the weight of multiple negative effects. The more cursed you are, the more negative effects you compile. Cursed Ciphers (and their associated Curses) are completely bound to the collecting player – they are not items, and cannot be traded or handed off, even when the collecting player becomes suppressed. 

– You each will have your own personal Cursed Cipher Collected Counter, but everyone gets rewarded for the Cursed Cipher instances carried to the exit, regardless of who did the carrying.

[h1]THE PLACE BETWEEN [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/6e6e9822c6b17fde49717ae8d36c1640f8bb9458.png[/img]

– There’s a place that lies in between our world and the next. A place where the Voices dwell and travel freely. These spaces are mysterious with countless unanswered questions. If you try hard enough, you might stumble upon an entryway to The Place Between. But how do you find them? What secrets lie within? Guess it’s time to start investigating...

[h1]BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

– Added new prank call audio for the “War Dial” power
– Improvements to the stealth model to prevent unfair detections in maze transition areas

To see a full list of functionality and cosmetic tweaks and fixes, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1745644286043169239/]look here[/url].

notes.title: The Blackout Club Gets a December Update and DLC Packs
notes.content:
The Blackout Club December Update is live! It’s beginning to look a lot like Christmas in Redacre. While our December update won’t be as large as the spooktacular Halloween update, we still delivered a few special gifts for you this holiday season. You can expect a new mission, a new prestige ranking system, new additions to the store and more.  

[h2]NEW MISSIONS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/0ecb82b6246672bc1dd068fdab3c0ef4c8979f68.png[/img]

PJ Party

– Do you hear what I hear? That’s the sound of Sleepers falling unconscious by the hands of Redacre’s slyest. Tiptoe around the neighborhood planting signal blockers on unsuspecting Sleepers. Once you’ve planted all of the signal blockers, run to a designated “safe zone” and detonate to knock all of them out. But what to do with all of these unconscious Sleepers? Better ease up on the holiday cookies, because you’ll have to muster up your strength and endurance to carry all of the unconscious Sleepers to the target area without making a peep. The PJ Party mission unlocks at Level 6, and the more challenging version of the mission unlocks at Level 12.

[h2]EXPRESS YOUR DEVOTION[/h2]

– We’ve added a brand new way for players to express their devotion for their Voice of choice. The new prestige system called, “Devotion” allows players to sacrifice their body and XP to one of the Voices, causing their devotion to deepen. There are five tier brackets of devotion, with the last being at 500,000 sacrifice total. Players may sacrifice to any number of Voices. Each time a player reaches a new tier, they get a new jacket cosmetic. And now, players can see how much XP they’ve sacrificed to a particular Voice. So, who are you most devoted to? 

[h2]PLAY BACK DREAMS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/de9e50544f074520ef99104fdf8812c1da231ae8.png[/img]

– Ever heard an interesting dream and wanted to delve into the message more? Well, now you can. The Journal Menu now allows you to play back Dreams and read them like journal entries. You can also listen to past Dreams you’ve had and Broadcasts you’ve heard in the journal. 

[h2]TESTING, TESTING...IS THIS THING ON?[/h2]

– We know it’s important you’re heard in The Blackout Club. That’s why we’ve added a microphone test in the Hideout near the Sacrifice Mirror. You’ll be able to test your mic level and how you sound before recording a message with your Light of Rebellion. 

[h2]NEW STORE ASSETS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/95bc90ecf20fbbdb55b98197637fbf5307ea756c.png[/img]

– To celebrate our new PJ Party mission, we’ve added four festive pajama sets in the Shop (complete with tops and bottoms). And we know the holidays wouldn’t be complete without an ugly sweater, so we’ve added two. 

[h2]NEIGHBORHOOD DECORATIONS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/3d150af354ceb245197a483f5b5a0ba5561959d2.png[/img]

– Take in the holiday view at the decorations strung about the neighborhood in Redacre and the Old Growth Daycare. 

[h2]BUG FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

– You can now carry bodies up ladders and open doors while holding them.
– Fix for "tranq dart was consumed and not used" when you are grabbed by an enemy.
– Fix for when "lucid insta-reported a downed body across the map".
– New animation feedback when opening reward chests in the hideout. 
– some animation fixes
– Some vertex weight fixes to various customization meshes (tops/pants) so they don't stretch out.
– Options Menu has an option now for toggling the new "Threat Indicator" arrows in the UI on/off.


[h1]DLC PACKS[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/2cbc1fa635748a87d47aaabdd0f66bd291ebccb4.png[/img]

– The Blackout Club December Update just went live, and you know we couldn’t stop there. These DLC packs are all about expressing your devotion for your Voice of choice. Our eight new DLC packs (one for each Daimon) include three cosmetic items: 2 kid customizations (t-shirt and jacket), and 2 hideout decorations (a wall hanging featuring their logo and the 3D model "icon"). Hang your new hideout decorations on the wall or place your special icon on the ground or table. 

[u][b]Please note, the DLC packs are cosmetic only and do not in any way affect gameplay. [/b][/u]

- Dance-For-Us
- Die-For-You
- In-Her-Teeth
- Laugh-Last
- Speak-As-One
- Seed-The-Grudge
- Thee-I-Dare
- The-Measure-Cuts

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
[b]The Blackout Club Halloween Update is live! [/b]

Redacre has undergone a spooktacular transformation for the Halloween season. Sneering pumpkins, festive lights, witches and ghouls adorn the houses of Hoadly, but that’s not all of the treats we have in store for you. You can expect three new missions, stealth gameplay tweaks, and new additions to the store like Halloween masks, spooky shirts and hideout decorations.   
                              
[h1]NEW MISSIONS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/b0d3ddc24f0cb5f9250e74be2f254d00cb136dd6.gif[/img]

[u]Egg The Lucids[/u]

It’s that time of year where mischief and mayhem fills the air, and it’s just the right time of year to get revenge on the sinister adult Lucids. Skulk around the neighborhood searching for buckets of rotten eggs placed in strategic locations. Each egg may have a “special” message for one lucky Lucid!  Chuck your eggs at Lucids as many times as it takes to make them seem sick or grossed out (oh you’ll know). This level unlocks once you’ve scrambled up to Level 5!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/86b5c9ab1e01e9f33ac04a60e50587b5f4d695d2.gif[/img]

[u]Dance Fever[/u]

In Redacre, music is always more than it seems...right? This Halloween, it’s up to you to put the pep back in the enemy’s steps. Get as many as you can to rattle some bones in a Redacre dance-off by playing a song on your phone. But heed our warning: [b]Angels don’t dance.[/b] The Shape is always watching, so dance if you dare. You won’t be able to dance the night away and unlock this mission until you reach Level 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/223a5c131e8594cfd42a8fde6d95acf97606fd70.png[/img]

[u]Signal Relay[/u]

Build a network of connected relays between two endpoints in the maze. You can unlock this mission once you reach Level 4. 

[h1]NEW STORE ASSETS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/4538ccb173b325318ba893d3a90487bb959243aa.jpg[/img]

No Halloween update would be complete without our own set of Halloween-themed masks! Now you’ll be able to get a witch mask, eyeball mask, pumpkin mask, vampire mask, and hockey mask.

Complete your mask with new Halloween shirts and spooky art depicting cats, bats, and even a Calaveras for the Día de los Muertos. 

Show off your Halloween spirit by decorating your hideout with our brand new hideout decorations. Now you can add jack-o-lanterns, a witch’s cauldron, a tombstone, wall hangings, and Halloween posters featuring haunted houses, skeletons, and Día de los Muertos. 

[h1]NEIGHBORHOOD DECORATIONS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222500/f9bdceba27cdb9456b64b1fa7d5c5534833149ff.gif[/img]

Decorations are viewable in front of houses and in every yard. You can also see new festive posters in Old Growth daycare.

Many of these decorations can be bought in the store to decorate your Hideout!

[h1]BUG FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
We made some gameplay tweaks and tuning around stealth to feel more fair for our players, and easier to understand. 

New Halloween missions begin unlocking once you reach Level 3. 

We’ve also made adjustments so that some missions unlock at different levels than they have in the past.

Visit the "Discussions" forum [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1606022547906615714/]here[/url] in Steam to read the full patch notes. Also, please check out [url=https://discord.gg/theblackoutclub]our official Discord[/url] to chat with other members of the club!

[i]Thanks again for all your support and for playing! See ya round the neighborhood![/i]
Boo,
>Question

notes.title: Welcome to 1.0 Launch!!!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/7bdc497a865b5b9094f3d2cd1721428f6fbb4b76.jpg[/img]

This marks the end of the Early Access period and the transition to full launch! Thanks to all the players who joined us on the journey to get here and who helped us grow and improve the game over the past 8 months!

[b][u][h1]OLD GROWTH[/h1][/u][/b]
The biggest addition with the release of 1.0 is the 3rd large above ground region, "[b]Old Growth[/b]".[b] Old Growth[/b] is home to a [i]perfectly normal[/i] daycare facility used by many families in Redacre. It is recommended you don't poke around in the basement though, employees only.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/82246ffe6fbcb55ab82bceeb659346e42d8973de.jpg[/img]

It also includes some woods and other outdoor spaces, including a playground. The size of Old Growth is close to the size of the two existing above ground areas combined and it brings with it new connections to the maze. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/1488e065507ac589580e02713496dbb20e3722f5.jpg[/img]

[h1][u][b]FIXES AND POLISH[/b][/u][/h1]

In addition, the release into 1.0 brings a bunch of fixes and further polish to the game. Some areas that received particular attention are issues with collision that could make trees a pain to navigate around, problems with AI pathfinding, fixes to numerous level art issues, and lots more. For a full list, look [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/2944710017720885686/]here[/url].

[b][u][h1]RUSSIAN SUBTITLES[/h1][/u][/b]
Do to popular demand the 1.0 build has added Russian subtitles and interface! 

As we have said since entering early access, with full launch comes a price increase. The game has far more to offer than it did when we first released in October, and the price has increased to reflect that. 

Thanks again to everyone who has joined the club, we look forward to welcoming many more! Have fun uncovering the many mysteries that lie above and below Redacre's streets, and don't forget to [b][i]close your eyes[/i][/b].

-Question

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #9: READY FOR TROUBLE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/ca3784713fbde5efe8f37b634b7a61b69a703212.gif[/img]

Welcome to the 9th update to [i]The Blackout Club[/i]! With this update lots has changed as we get closer to release of 1.0. We have totally overhauled the reward system, implemented LOTS of big performance optimizations, and done a lot of polish work on the neighborhood. 

So lets get into the details!

[h1][u][b]ECONOMY AND REWARDS[/b][/u][/h1]

[u][b]SNACKS[/b][/u]
Rewards have been changed to introduce a new reward type on mission complete: [b]Snacks[/b]. Snacks are traded in the new [b]store [/b]located on the customization menu for character and hideout customizations (more about those below). You can only get snacks by completing missions, they are never purchased with real money, so this is [b]not [/b]introducing microtransactions.

At the end of a mission you earn a badge based on the percentage of the possible XP you earned.  The higher the badge, the more snacks you will receive. This means that to really get the most snacks, [b]bonus evidence is important[/b]. In addition, as you level up, snacks and XP rewards will also rise to account for the bigger level (more ground to cover) and increased difficulty. Along with this the level curve has been adjusted to be less grindy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/bae8bc79bcb56dfb17284c7279597d03703b1b10.png[/img]

[u][b]THE STORE[/b][/u]
With the addition of snacks comes a store where you trade them for customizations. The store has a weekly stock and a daily special. The weekly selection updates every week, and the daily every day (probably obvious). 

[u][b]HIDEOUT CUSTOMIZATIONS[/b][/u]
You can now purchase customizations for your hideout with snacks! These come in the form of props and posters. When you purchase one you choose where to place it in the customization menu. In addition, when joining another person's game your customizations will come with you as long as the host doesn't have anything already in that slot!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/8604d212ae4eda192dcb0d35c50835e5446199ba.png[/img]

[u][b]SOME HIGHLIGHTS OF THE NEW SYSTEM[/b][/u]
[list][*] We have added lots of items to the "Accessories" category of customizations. These include a variety of[b] masks, bandanas, and some other surprises[/b].
[*] [b]More clothing options[/b] have been added to the other categories as well.
[*] [b]NO MORE DUPES![/b] Since you choose what rewards to spend snacks on you never get duplicate items. They are no longer randomly dropped on mission complete.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/61aa7ee2a24bfe4b2f02f5c0fa13e06b9d61e0c5.png[/img]

[h1][u][b]SUPPLY DROPS[/b][/u][/h1]
You can also now use snacks in missions for special favors from club headquarters! New Supply Drops have been added to the game in the form of[b] Firework Stations - above ground[/b] and [b]Contraband Lockers - in the maze[/b]. For some snacks you can request a specific item that you really need and the club will air drop it or send you the code for the locker! For when you [i]REALLY [/i]need that tranq!

[h1][u][b]PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS[/b][/u][/h1]
We have done a lot of work with this update to improve performance across the board, both for CPU and GPU. Almost everyone should see a pretty big performance boost, especially hosts.

[h1][u][b]WORLD POLISH[/b][/u][/h1]
We have done a lot of work on the neighborhood to give more of a sense that people [i]LIVE HERE[/i]. Each home now has more personality that tells a little more about the inhabitants, and when reading journals you might be able to connect some dots! We also did a fair amount of general polish on them as well.

[h1][u][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/u][/h1]
With this update we now have [b]subtitles for German, Spanish, and French[/b]. There is still a little more polish work to do on these, but we believe it is fairly complete and playable. Please let us know!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/0b4577f03fddc87e8270619337afb0c974e7346b.jpg[/img]

[u][h1][b]TWO NEW MISSION TYPES[/b][/h1][/u]
[list][*] [b]Record Behavior[/b] -  In this mission you are required to set up a special circle that compels the enemies to engage in strange behavior. Set the trap, lure an enemy in, then record it as evidence!
[*] [b]Follow the Trail[/b] -  this is a high level version of the rescue club kid mission, but you don't know where they were taken. You have to go to where they were abducted, record evidence in the area, then follow the trail that was left to where they are now. You won't know if they are OK until you find them!
[/list]

There is lots more in this update including lots of bug fixes, the ability to [b]increase the filter distance on available lobbies[/b], and other surprises (what are those sleepers doing?) so keep a look out when playing. You can find additional details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1640912849403314164/]here[/url]. In addition we have done a lot of work preparing the next large above ground region, which will be unlocked with the next major update. As always thanks for playing, see you in the neighborhood!

-Question


UPDATE: Hotfix 6/2 for a few bugs, details posted in the change list

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #8: WHISPERS
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/65e877217a16648d739fca725b77564aea1753ea.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the [b]Seventh Early Access update[/b] to The Blackout Club! 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1812044473311188147/]Full Patch Notes for Update 8 Can Be Found HERE on the Forum[/url]

This update brings with it a lot of quality-of-life improvements, better UI, LOTS AND LOTS of behind-the-scenes optimization which will hopefully improve performance on lower-end machines, and some neat new features. We also did some balance changes, including changes to the Prank Caller skill tree.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/90b0845738376a1337ece616e708290bb97bff4b.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]NEW FEATURES/CONTENT[/u]:[/h1]

[list]
[*] You'll find some new kids hanging out in the Hideout, the [b]Whisper Twins[/b], a pair of random NPC kid buddies who occasionally discuss the latest rumors and events in Redacre after players complete missions.
[*] We've also added a new experimental [b]"Screenshot Mode"[/b] by popular request, which allows you to disable the HUD for a more immersive gameplay experience, or just to grab sweet beautiful screenshots. Press Alt+V to toggle this on/off. :)
[*] You will find a new [b]Club Handbook [/b]in the Hideout . This is a simple tutorial user guide to make our new user experience cleaner. (Let us know in the forums what else you wish you knew when starting the game, so we can improve the experience for future new players!)
[*] and more!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/c3ed15c6a642c2b835b4766388d5e8e9392c422f.png[/img]

[h1][u]BALANCE CHANGES[/u]:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The [b]Prank Call skill tree[/b] received the most attention this update, and in general has received a bit of a nerf. The cooldown on this ability has been increased, and enemies will no longer fall for the entire prank call recording before hanging up. Also, durations have been added for hacked cameras and traps, so work fast!
[*] We've made a bunch of background [b]improvements to AI[/b] including their pathfinding in tight spaces and areas which require you to crouch. Some of your favorite hiding places may not be so safe in the future!
[*] The [b]LUCKY LOOT [/b]power has also changed to allow you to get a chance for double loot items for all field items in chests, not just ammo types. 
[*] and more!
[/list]

Check out the full notes linked above for the rest (there's a lot more!). We didn't even mention all the new UI, including a new Ritual Menu! Now you can get rid of that body in style, before the Lucids get to you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/714a3182b6a9faff03e5eb56279a42749a9695dc.jpg[/img]

As always, we love to hear your thoughts in the comments and forums. Please check out the [url=https://discord.gg/theblackoutclub]Discord server[/url] to find other players to play with, discuss strategies and tips, or share your speculation about the mysteries beneath Redacre! 

Thanks and see you around the neighborhood!
-Question

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #7: SOMNILOQUY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/a1e051a1507726413ce6d8da5102b80d5a17087d.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the seventh Early Access update to [i]The Blackout Club[/i]. This update brings several new maze areas and connections, a new mission, lots of improved UI, and fixes in numerous areas!

[h1][u][b]NEW ADDITIONS[/b][/u][/h1]

[u][b]NEW MISSION: Hide The Evidence[/b][/u]
Uh-oh, looks like a club member has caused a nasty bit of trouble during a blackout (it involves doves and blood, ewww). If CHORUS finds out  it could mean big trouble. Find and remove the evidence, receive bonus XP for cleaning up the trail they left in their wake!

[u][b]NEW AREA: The Barracks[/b][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/37586586f7acbb1248b656979ec3a45e1fce4067.jpg[/img]
Some of the sleepers no longer leave the maze, they have been fully consumed. This is where they live.


[u][b]NEW AREAS: Somniloquy(s)[/b][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/00aac788ccd8b31a14385b6b60de65ade9601cfc.jpg[/img]
A pair of areas with an unknown purpose. What are those smoke filled chambers? Why are there two of these large rooms isolated by space and sound insulation? The maze keeps its secrets....

[u][b]NEW UI[/b][/u]
We have updated quite a bit of the UI! [b] Leaderboards, Journals, Team Info, Inventory, and Session Menus have all been overhauled[/b]. Of particular note,[b] the new session menu asks hosts to specify whether they would prefer a public or friends only game[/b]. We are hoping this resolves some of the confusion that has led some to kick players when they join mid-game.

[b][h1][u]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/u][/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]When performing a ritual with a Light of Rebellion you will now be asked to specify what Voice you want your sacrifice to go to[/b]. What does that mean? Only one way to find out.
[*][b] Indomitable has been nerfed[/b]. We discovered that Indomitable was refilling faster than we intended, allowing it to be too much of a speed run build. We have rebalanced the amount of injury required to recharge the power. Sorry to all who got used to lots of free sprinting!
[*] [b]Added ability to Opt-Out of Stalker Mode[/b]. Some players have said they would like to no longer be stalked after deciding the mode is not for them. We added a button in the Options Menu that will reset your stalker settings. This means that you will be invaded ONE MORE TIME if you reset, but after that you will not be invaded as a host if you don't stalk anyone else. This option is only available to those who have stalked other players (meaning they have opted-in)
[/list]

[h1][u][b]FIXES AND OPTIMIZATIONS[/b][/u][/h1]

This update features a number of fixes and attempts to make the game run better. Some highlights are:

[list]
[*] Changes to replication to reduce the CPU load on the host machine
[*] Ragdoll improvements for AI (should be less juddery, react better to crossbow)
[*] Many, many UI fixes
[*] Fix for AI getting into an unresponsive state
[*] Fix for getting stuck in the sleeping bag on load (rare, but very annoying)
[*] Fixes to footstep guide to prevent it walking into the sky for no good reason
[*] And More!
[/list]

The full update list will be posted on the forums and a link will be updated here once it is ready! Thanks again to all the club members who are fighting the good fight in Redacre, and all the stalkers who are ratting them out! We hope you have fun and we appreciate all the feedback and support.

-Question

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #6: THE PLEXUS
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/24e6dcb5dbcc74179c09ed11ddfcaa48a59a6aaa.gif[/img]

Welcome to the sixth major update to [i]The Blackout Club[/i] since entering Early Access last Halloween! This update brings some new areas to the maze, a new mission, and a number of tweaks and changes to gameplay!

[h1][u][b]NEW ADDITIONS[/b][/u][/h1]

[b]NEW MISSION: Drone Repair.[/b] 
In this mission the kids are tasked with repairing a wounded drone, then following it as it leads them to its dropped payload! You might find some extra bonus evidence along the way. ;)

[b]NEW AREA: The Plexus[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/ad1a8436a33d9710beb781c7816a88966bd4dda3.jpg[/img]

A large new area to the maze that unlocks at level 8. 

[b]NEW AREA: Signal Relay[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/534c8dc30ffbaf0432c8a247c2a762f72f22dfa1.jpg[/img]

A smaller area behind The Plexus that unlocks at level 9.

[h1][u][b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b][/u][/h1]
Large changes have been made to some items, as well as a Major Power track we introduced last update, and some other balance changes to the Stalker mode which we hope will address some frustrations people told us about. The underground Maze has some new connections, Stun Guns no longer require 9V batteries, and we started work on a new customization category, Accessories!

[list]
[*] Flashbangs and tranq darts will no longer freeze kids OR stalkers in place. 
[*] Flashbangs temporarily blind you and rotate you in a random direction (kinda like pin the tail on the donkey, if you ever played that as a kid). Watch out or you might run right into your enemy's arms! 
[*] Tranq darts now deplete stamina completely and prevent stamina regen briefly. They also inflict a small wound, lowering overall stamina. The intent is for these to no longer be guaranteed wins for either the kids or the stalker, we will be watching how these changes play out!
[*] The INDOMITABLE power track now grants infinite sprint in addition to wound invulnerability for its duration. We felt this power was weak compared to the others and needed some buffing. It might be too OP now... let us know!
[*] The STUN GUN no longer requires batteries, but will recharge automatically over time. You can see the recharge on the battery meter on the stun gun when holding it. We felt this item needed a buff to feel as useful as the others. This also means that 9V batteries have been removed from the loot tables.
[*] New customization category: Accessories. There is a new category of customizations now for customizations we will be adding in the future. There is not much in it yet (one thing), but that will change in future updates.
[*] New connections in the maze. We have connected areas in the maze with new routes to give players more options when navigating. We also made some adjustments to Dream Therapy to force players to go deeper inside when passing through.
[*] [b]Achievements[/b] Implemented! Players can now receive Steam achievements when playing the game. :)
[*] Subtitles added for AI VO. Subtitle support got a huge boost this update with subtitles now being properly implemented for most Lucid and Sleeper VO. There is more to come, but for those of you who prefer subtitles you should have most of the game covered now... not just the Prologue anymore.
[/list]

[h1][u][b]FIXES[/b][/u][/h1]

As usual this build has numerous fixes and the full list will be posted in the forums (will update this post with a link once ready). Some of the more notable fixes are:

[list]
[*] Attempts to make stalker dossier counts more reliable. They were very inconsistent before.
[*] Fix to make sure ladder climbing options are properly respected in game
[*] Fix to incorrect mission complete screen when a stalker was captured
[*] Improved region select UI
[*] Collision fixes in the map
[*] Various typos and text cleanup to reflect the gameplay changes
[/list]

We really can't thank everyone enough for your feedback, comments, and bug reports these past few months. They are all helping us evolve and shape up this game to be the best it can be and we hope you're having fun!  Don't forget to check out the Discord (discord.gg/theblackoutclub) and our Steam Community Hub for the latest news and updates.

Most of all THANK YOU for playing and spreading the word! 

See you around the neighborhood,
~the Question team

notes.title: HOTFIX FOR UPDATE #5
notes.content:
The update today is an attempt to fix some crash issues users have been experiencing (SORRY!). It is also makes some adjustments to the recently added Stalker Mode.

The goal with these changes is to hopefully give players better information about the intended role of the stalker in the game. The biggest change is the removal of the WINS leaderboard for stalker. Stalkers will now only receive long term rewards for high scores which are achieved by recording the club and their sins, and causing full mission fail will no longer be the goal.

The reason for this is that [i]The Blackout Club[/i] is a co-op experience first and foremost, and the stalkers are designed to be an obstacle that a well organized team can overcome. They are intended to add an unpredictable human threat to the co-op game, but not to create a full PVP focused experience. To that end, stalkers should aim to last as long as possible, recording as much as they can, generate paranoia, before they are caught.

All that said, we do not consider the Stalker mode perfectly tuned and we will continue to watch how it fits into the overall experience and make changes moving forward. Early Access is a time for us to refine the game based on player feedback as well as our own goals.

As always THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR PLAYING. We really appreciate your time and feedback! Have fun in Redacre!

UPDATE: We updated again after finding that there was still a crash affecting some people. We are pretty sure this time the main issue is fixed, but please let us know in crash reports on the forum OR by sending crashes to bugreports@questiongames.com

-Question

notes.title: UPDATE #5: ENTER THE STALKER
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/f3c6f3a7c91cddba6164adae08ac4b00f6b44736.gif[/img]

[b][u][h1]PLAY AS A TRAITOR TO THE CLUB[/h1][/u]
[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/c8a4118e7ed3d083aa8f5589bc9b92a432218eaf.jpg[/img]

The primary focus of this update has been the introduction of the new STALKER MODE. Playing as a stalker pits you as a kid working against the club. You invade their missions and record them for the enemy. Every time you record them or their crimes their sins are logged, notifying the nearby AI and eventually calling out [i]The Shape[/i]. Once the shape is out, every recording shows the shape where the kids are. You are victorious if every member of the club is put to sleep by the shape. [i]THIS IS VERY HARD TO DO![/i] The stalker is very weak relative to the club, so victory will be rare. Your score is stored however and you can be rewarded just for that. More on that later.

To invade a game requires a [b]STALKER DOSSIER[/b]. These are seeded into the world on conditions you will have to discover yourself and will be rare initially. When you invade a game you can move between red doors and enter unnannouced. The kids wil NOT know you are there until you start recording them or their sins. Each time you do this they receive an in game message. If they catch you, YOU LOSE, if they complete their mission, you ALSO LOSE.  So be sneaky, be careful, choose your moments! You can return to the red doors after a cooldown, use them smartly to lose pursuit and confuse your enemies.

[b][u][h1]CATCH THE VENOMOUS TRAITOR[/h1][/u]
[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/40110a55e015043b81c61072952cbfeccd18dab0.jpg[/img]

As loyal club kids you may be invaded by a stalker after reaching LEVEL 5! When they enter your mission you will NOT KNOW until they start recording you. Work as a team to bring them down for bonus XP. The kid that catches the stalker also gets added to the leaderboard and gets a little extra XP. [b]AFTER YOU HAVE BEEN INVADED ONCE, YOU WILL NOT BE INVADED AGAIN UNLESS YOU INVADE SOMEONE ESLE[/b]. Once you have invaded another player, all games you host can be invaded going forward -[b] INVASION IS OPTING INTO STALKER MODE[/b]. Stalkers can only invade missions that have more than one player to make sure the club kids have the advantage. So team up if you want to see Stalkers!

 [u][h1]NEW LEADERBOARDS, UNIQUE REWARDS[/h1][/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/2485548a96bf45eefd6b956011e7a9b72655cd88.jpg[/img]

With this update come new leaderboards: [b]Most Stalkers Caught[/b], [b]Most Wins As Stalker[/b], and [b]Highest Stalker Score[/b]. Every week these leaderboards will reset, and the players at the top of each will receive a unique customization that can only be earned through this system! You can view the Stalker Wins and Score in the new Stalker Van (available after level 5), and the Stalkers Caught leaderboard is visible in the normal hideout.

[b] [u][h1]A LIVING EXPERIMENT[/h1][/u][/b]

We have tested this mode internally as much as we could, but we realize that the reality with live players could be very different. We expect to continue to iterate on this mode and make changes based on community feedback. Invasions may be too rare or too common, Stalkers might not have enough missions available to invade, there is much we expect to learn and we look forward to hearing what you think. Stalking is not available ALL THE TIME by design, we consider this an addition, not the core mode of play.

[b][u][h1]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/u][/b]

As usual this update comes with many fixes and improvements including basic eye animations for the kids (your eyes even close when you shut them in game), a new Sleeper pajama mesh (hi mom!), and fixes to missions and level geo. There have also been [b]significant [/b]optomizations to reduce load on the CPU, which should really help framerates on host players. To see that full list you can go to the forums and look [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1741105805751610966/]here[/url]

THANK YOU ALL FOR PLAYING!

-Question

notes.title: Early Access Update #4: ENHANCED HORROR
notes.content:
[h1][u]Happy Holidays From Redacre[/u][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/f74356707798499977d284ee8a0b94a5b54050b2.png[/img]

This marks the fourth update of [i]The Blackout Club[/i] since entering early access. Thanks to all who have joined up to fight the forces menacing Redacre, hopefully you are having fun!

[u][h1]ENHANCED HORROR UPDATE[/h1][/u]
When you launch [i]The Blackout Club[/i], you will be asked whether you want to opt in to the Enhanced Horror System. This allows the game to listen to and record your vocalizations if you have a microphone active and use it to create the most immersive possible horror experience, both for you and other players.   It will not affect your voice chat settings, you can still turn off the ability of fellow players to hear you (if you prefer a 3rd party voice application) without sacrificing the Enhanced Horror experience. Certain features such as the Ritual system require that you opt in to Enhanced Horror. Phobia warning: Paranormal Stimuli.

NOTE: This does [b]NOT[/b] mean that the AI in game will hear your microphone. We have seen some confusion on this and want to make that clear. 

[u][h1]A NEW MAZE AREA - DREAM THERAPY[/h1][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/dc5f8379f85532b4bb017da0654289f10fe55f06.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/f9f910b03023d9f0beb781cabea45af918f60ee1.jpg[/img]

We have added a fairly large addition to the maze that unlocks at Level 7. We hope you enjoy it and look forward to your feedback! What is its purpose? What happens in a sleeper's dreams?

[u][h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h1][/u]
There have been quite a few tweaks and adjustments to gameplay in this update, some of the largest are:
[list]
[*] [b]The Cross Country major power track has been completely reworked as the Unstoppable power track[/b]. You activate this power by holding down the power button (R or RB on gamepad by default). For the next several seconds you are immune to being wounded, deploy at strategic moments to gain the upper hand! The only way to recharge the power is to experience pain (get wounded), bandages are your new best friend. We look forward to feedback on this power.
[*] [b]Most major powers now have cooldowns! [/b]Prank call in particular has a long cool down to prevent it being too over powered and make its use feel more tactical and less reactive. 
[*] [b]The Prank Caller track is now the Hacker track[/b]. The ability to hack cameras and mines are now a part of the Hacker track and are no longer minor powers.
[*] [b]New minor powers have been added[/b]. Some of them let you choose items to start a mission with.
[*] [b]Leveling rates have been adjusted[/b]. Leveling at higher levels should now be faster.
[*] [b]The Shape has become more dangerous[/b]. Once you are past level 5 the shape will be a more formidable adversary (we didn't want to crush brand new playters). In addition, it has some new surprises for players who make it too angry.
[*] [b]A NEW THREAT: SPEED TRAPS[/b]. The meddling kids are too fast! Now there are motion activated traps that will zap any kid moving fast and reckless enough. Watch out for their telltale red laser pattern.
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32222500/85c158d40041d7bb61a124c832c7a1924507e93e.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]NEW MISSION: FOAM PARTY[/b]. Speaking of those nasty Speed Traps, a mission has been added to run around and hit a bunch of them with big goopy blobs of foam. Shuts 'em right down. They think they can slow down The Club? Think again.
[*] [b]Totally redesigned options and system UI[/b]. We finally replaced the old temp UI for options and system menus for something that should be cleaner to navigate and much nicer to look at!
[*][b] AND MUCH MORE....[/b]
[/list]

This update had a lot in it, these are just the big changes. Lots of other adjustments to balance, powers and many, many fixes also went in. To see the full list take a look [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1741103267271136465/]here [/url]on the forums. 

Thanks again to everyone who has supported us in early access! Your feedback is invaluable to making this game the best it can be. We are always listening and we hope you have a wonderful and happy holiday. See you in Redacre (watch out for Stalkers).

-Question

notes.title: Early Access Update #3!!
notes.content:
Welcome to the third update to [i]The Blackout Club[/i] since we launched early access a month ago! Due to the Thanksgiving holiday in the US and the wildfires that affected the Bay Area, this update is a little lighter than we would usually like, but we still wanted to get you all something! The full list can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1741101364289794572/]on the forums[/url], but here are some of the highlights:

[u][h1]GAMEPLAY TWEAKS AND ADDITIONS[/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]NEW MISSION: A New Campaign[/b] - The kids decided the posters are not enough, and have branched out to use disguised political yard signs for their recruitment efforts! 
[*] [b]NEW MISSION: We're Listening[/b] -  The kids sneak into houses and install cheap sound bugs in fake wall sockets. Who knows, maybe some sleeper will let something slip in a dream - maybe they'll even overhear the real name of a lucid. Any info could be a weapon.
[*] [b]The Ritual Room is open in MP sessions now[/b]. We consider this an important (if mysterious) part of the game, and locking it behind a single player gate always felt wrong. Now one person at a time can make sacrifices and perform prayers during MP sessions. Fun for the whole club!
[*] [b]Players will sometimes dream when returning to the hideout[/b] (????????)
[/list]

[u][h1]BUGFIXES AND ITERATION[/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]We made numerous optimizations to attempt to improve CPU performance[/b]. We have more to do here, but we tried to make a dent. Let us know if it seems better or worse.
[*][b] A number of bugfixes related to AI[/b], such as getting stuck at the bottom of ladders, getting stuck dragging on some stairways, and bumping off of cliff geometry.
[*][b] Level fixes[/b] such as an issue with some light switches in the prologue blocking interaction and a bad path link near the Hoadly East cliff edge.
[*] [b]Input tweaks[/b] such as allowing for even lower mouse sensitivity settings, separate sliders for mouse and gamepad sensitivity, and separate options for invert Y on gamepad and mouse.
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUE[/b]: In certain cases the footprints that help guide you to the next objective will fail to go where they should. We hope to have that fixed next update!

There are a few more fixes and tweaks that can be found in the full list on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1741101364289794572/]forums[/url]. 

As always, thanks to all the club members who have given such great feedback, helped us find bugs, and most importantly, played and [b]enjoyed[/b] the game! We know early access is a risky proposition, we truly appreciate your patience and time!

-Question

notes.title: Early Access Update #2 - New Content and Fixes!
notes.content:
We are pleased to be rolling out our second update to [i]The Blackout Club[/i]. This update marks the first of our new update schedule, which should come about every two weeks moving forward. The focus on this update was getting some new content in the game while continuing to fix bugs and start to address feedback and balance issues.

[h1][u]NEW AREAS[/u][/h1]
This update features access to a some new areas in the maze! One room in particular has a few tricks up its sleeve as well as opening up some new routes to other areas. 

[h1][u]QUEST UPDATE[/u][/h1]
The cryptogram mission has an extra challenge added for higher level players (for more XP as well). Use the cryptograms with projectors to read their contents and record the evidence you find. The old shorter version of the mission still shows up for low-level players.

[u][h1]NEW QUEST CATEGORY: DISRUPT[/h1][/u]
The club is going to start doing some recruitment of new members, as well as test out a new approach to dealing with the Instrument. We're interested to hear thoughts on these new objectives :)

[u][h1]GAMEPLAY AND OPTIONS HIGHLIGHTS[/h1][/u]
We made a number of changes based on what we have seen as well as the things people have been asking for on the forums and discord.

[list]
[*] [b]A new threat![/b] The Lucids are aware that some meddling kids are sneaking around where they shouldn't be. Since they can't be everywhere at once, they've introduced these new Acoustic Mines. They're in new locations every night, so be on the lookout.
[*] [b]UNSTOPPABLE has been nerfed![/b] Looking at statistics and feedback we decided that the Unstoppable track needed adjusting. It turns out Infinite sprint is game breaking!! (who could have guessed). The "Unstoppable" powers have now become extensions of Cross Country. (Sorry to anyone who is super upset with this, but during early access we will continue to tweak all the power tracks)
[*] [b]New sin feedback[/b]. We overhauled how sins are presented to the player. You are now given feedback about which actions [i]are[/i] sins (spoiler: most things), we show whether a sin has been discovered (primarily locked doors and bodies), and the item will glow at a long distance when it IS discovered, hopefully helping people know WHY they suddenly woke the shape.
[*] [b]You can now uncap your framerate[/b] in the video options! You have to turn off smoothed framerate and and vsync for this to work. 
[*] [b]You can now set your session type (Friends only or public) from the hosting screen[/b] to reduce confusion.
[*] There is now a  [b]control option for crouch toggle[/b] for those that prefer it.
[*] [b]Sacrifice now comes with a choice![/b] (what does it do?)
[*][b] Kick Player added to team info screen[/b] to allow a host to kick toxic players. This will ban that player from your session until you close and reopen the game
[/list]

[h1][u]BUGFIX HIGHLIGHTS[/u][/h1]
We also continued to hammer on bugs reported by the community! There are way too many to list here, the full list can be seen [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/2479690531129409414/]in the forums[/url]

A big fix is economy related. We found that there was a bug in our item system that was granting people more than one "light of rebellion" at a time. This has been fixed, and you will only ever be awarded one in your inventory at a time and they [b]expire after 5 days[/b], so we recommend you use them when you get them (experiment!!).

This build has continuing improvements to animation (primarily rope/ladder climb and third person item hands), more fixes to AI - especially focusing on preventing the "pogo-jump" that they would sometimes do, fixes for "black screen on startup", crash fixes, and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/2479690531129409414/]LOTS MORE[/url].

Thanks again to all the people who have joined the club, we value your time and feedback, we hope to see you in Redacre (if you catch a stalker, then you met us)!

EDIT: There was a hot fix today to fix a bug in items being auto used, as well as additional fixes for drone strike!

-Question

notes.title: Week One Early Access Update with Hotfixes!!
notes.content:
We have just released the first week update for [i]The Blackout Club[/i]! 

First things first, this update does not have any major new content. We know people are hungry for it, and it is [b]coming soon[/b], but we wanted to get a bunch of much needed bug fixes and quality of life improvements to you as soon as possible. There is a lot in this update, so for the list of changes, see this pinned post on the discussion board: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/599080/discussions/0/1748980761791472038/]Changelog[/url]

Here are some highlights:

[h1][u][b]FIXES[/b][/u][/h1]
Some of the highlights in this build are a fix for the issue where you could start a mission and have no hero item, fixes to the yellow threat indicator not turning on when it should, fixes to items in loot boxes giving you negative values, and a fix to prevent getting stuck in the customization menu if you exit out of gesture menu editing.

[h1][u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u][/h1]
We also made some improvements to the eyes closed footstep helpers, added proper [b]feedback to the crossbow[/b] (you can now see a dart loaded if you have ammo), added feedback on the UI for when players are carrying mission critical items (such as cryptograms, evidence, etc), added onscreen notifications when mission items are dropped, and added feedback that all players get when bonus evidence is recorded as well as notification when you have [b]found ALL the bonus evidence in the level[/b].

In this build you can also escape a grapple with an enemy without sacrificing an escape item if you have the health. Previously this was automatic, but now if you want to shove and take a wound EVEN if you have an escape item, you can do so with RMB or LT. 

[h1][u][b]LADDERS[/b][/u][/h1]
A major change in response to what we have seen watching players is related to ladders. We tuned them to make them more reliable in general, but we also [b]ADDED A LADDER CONTROLS OPTION[/b]. We saw that people have some assumptions about how ladders work, so now you can change from the default look-based ladder movement to a fixed direction ladder movement in OPTIONS->CONTROLS if you prefer it. This means that instead of moving down when looking down and up when looking up, you will move up if you push forward and down if you push back if you select this change.

[h1][u][b]MISSIONS[/b][/u][/h1]
There have also been tweaks to some existing missions, adding more locations where they can take place (not new regions yet) to hopefully add some variety while you wait for the new stuff.

We are so grateful to everyone who has taken a chance on this game in early access!!! We hope you are enjoying your time in the club and we will be back soon with another update!

-Question
